title: Phase 6: Widget + Session Persistence + Polish + Testing
description:
Implement TUI widget, session persistence, and testing.

title: Phase 5: Lifecycle — Abort, Respond, Done Tools
description:
Implement crew_abort, crew_respond, and crew_done tools.

## Tasks
1. slices/lifecycle/lifecycle.types.ts — AbortConfig, RespondConfig, DoneConfig
2. slices/lifecycle/lifecycle.abort.ts — crew_abort: single (by id) or all. SIGTERM then SIGKILL.
3. slices/lifecycle/lifecycle.respond.ts — crew_respond: send follow-up to interactive subagent
4. slices/lifecycle/lifecycle.done.ts — crew_done: close interactive session, cleanup

## Key Behavior
- Abort: SIGTERM first, SIGKILL after timeout
- Respond: write to interactive subagent stdin via pipe/temp file
- Done: mark complete, dispose session resources

title: Phase 4: Chain + Comms — Sequential Workflow + Message Bus
description:
Implement crew_chain tool and inter-agent message bus.

## Tasks
1. slices/chain/chain.types.ts — ChainStep, ChainConfig, ChainStatus
2. slices/chain/chain.orchestrator.ts — Chain execution with {previous} placeholder
3. slices/chain/chain.tool.ts — crew_chain tool
4. slices/chain/chain.renderer.ts — TUI rendering for chain progress

## Key Behavior
- Sequential spawn with {previous} placeholder replacement
- Each step completion notified to main via steering
- Message bus for inter-agent requests
- Main relay: all communication reported to main agent

title: Phase 3: Blockers + Prompt — Write/Edit Block + System Prompt
description:
Block write/edit tools on main agent and inject system prompt.

## Tasks
1. slices/blockers/blockers.types.ts — BlockPolicy, BlockedToolConfig
2. slices/blockers/blockers.intercept.ts — tool_call event: block write/edit. Return { block: true, reason: 'Delegate to worker' }
3. slices/blockers/blockers.policy.ts — Configurable block policies
4. slices/prompt/prompt.types.ts — PromptInjectionConfig, AgentListFormat
5. slices/prompt/prompt.injector.ts — before_agent_start handler: inject agent list + instructions
6. slices/prompt/prompt.templates.ts — System prompt template strings

## Key Behavior
- Block: write, edit (bash optionally configurable)
- System prompt lists all available agents with capabilities + extensions
- Main agent instructed: NEVER write files, always delegate to subagents

title: Phase 2: Spawn Slice — Async Non-Blocking + --no-extension
description:
Implement crew_spawn tool with async non-blocking spawning.

## Tasks
1. slices/spawn/spawn.types.ts — SpawnConfig, SubagentHandle, SubagentStatus
2. slices/spawn/spawn.manager.ts — Process spawn: pi --mode json -p --no-session --no-extension [+optional --extension flags]. Parse JSON lines. Handle close/error. Async IIFE background. Abort signal.
3. slices/spawn/spawn.tool.ts — crew_spawn tool: agent, task, model?, interactive?. Return { subagent_id, status: 'spawned' }
4. slices/spawn/spawn.renderer.ts — TUI rendering (collapsed + expanded)
5. slices/spawn/spawn.widget.ts — Widget entries for running agents

## Key Behavior
- Default spawn: --no-session --no-extension --mode json -p
- Extensions injected only if agentConfig.extensions non-empty
- Result via pi.sendMessage({ deliverAs: 'steer', triggerTurn: true })
- Session entries on spawn + complete

title: Phase 1: Agent Discovery + Frontmatter Parser + Extension Resolver
description:
Implement agent discovery and extension resolution system.

## Tasks
1. slices/agents/agents.types.ts — AgentConfig, AgentExtensionRef, AgentScope types
2. slices/agents/agents.frontmatter.ts — YAML frontmatter parser (name, description, model, thinking, tools, skills, extensions, interactive, compaction)
3. slices/agents/agents.discovery.ts — Discover from user (~/.pi/agent/agents), project (.pi/agents), bundled (agents/). Extension resolver: path-based (absolute/relative) + pi-package (npm:/git:)
4. slices/agents/agents.registry.ts — Live agent registry with get/list
5. Bundled agent .md: worker.md, scout.md, researcher.md, reviewer.md, planner.md

## Key Behavior
- 3 discovery sources: user > project > bundled (priority order)
- Extensions field: resolve relative from agent .md loc, absolute, ~, npm:/git:
- Return structured AgentConfig[] with resolved extension refs

title: crew-of-pi: Async Non-Blocking Subagent Orchestration Extension
description:
Build pi extension for async non-blocking subagent orchestration.

## Requirements
1. Main context windows tetap bersih (isolated pi process)
2. Main agent tidak bisa tulis langsung (blockers + delegate)
3. Async non-blocking (steering messages)
4. Inter-subagent communication with main awareness
5. Automatic delegation via system prompt injection

## Architecture
- Vertical slice architecture (slices/*)
- --no-extension on spawn (prevent endless recursion)
- Per-agent extension loading (path-based + pi-package)

See docs/plan.md

title: Build DOX tree: child AGENTS.md files + root index
description:
The root AGENTS.md declares a DOX framework but its Child DOX Index says 'not yet indexed'. Need to:

1. Scan project recursively (done)
2. Create child AGENTS.md files for each durable folder boundary:
   - slices/ — vertical slice architecture core
   - agents/ — bundled subagent definitions
   - prompts/ — workflow templates
   - docs/ — project documentation
   - shared/ — shared types contract reference
3. Update root AGENTS.md with proper Child DOX Index
4. Remove stale text and ensure DOX hierarchy is consistent

This enables the DOX framework to work as designed: each subtree has its own contract, parent docs explain what children cover, and the closer a doc is to the work the more specific it is.
